read.thesis: Aggregates shipments up 17% to a record 61.6Mt but only 2.3% organic; ASP down 2% on acquisition mix, aggregates gross profit per ton fell 17%, and revenue guidance was raised with EBITDA held at $2.36-2.5B.

capex.quote: Through disciplined inventory management and reductions in capital spending, we have unlocked more than $200 million of cash year-to-date

triggers.label: Capex reduced; $350M cash flow benefits
triggers.quote: expected to generate approximately $350 million of annualized cash flow improvements as we optimize our evolving asset base, network footprint, and sustaining capital requirements
triggers.highlight: $350 million of annualized cash flow improvements

triggers.label: Organic mix-adjusted ASP +3.7%
triggers.quote: organic mix-adjusted ASP increased 3.7 percent, reflecting continued strong organic shipment momentum in the Central and West Divisions

guidance.quote: we are raising our full-year revenue guidance to a range of $7.2 billion to $7.4 billion

guidance.metric: Full-year Adjusted EBITDA from continuing operations
guidance.quote: reaffirming our full-year Adjusted EBITDA from continuing operations guidance of $2.36 billion to $2.5 billion

red_flags.label: Operating cash flow down 44% H1
red_flags.quote: Cash provided by operating activities for the six months ended June 30, 2026, was $339 million, compared with $605 million

red_flags.label: Net debt rises with $13.5B LNA deal
red_flags.quote: transaction valued at approximately $13.5 billion, consisting of cash and shares of Martin Marietta common stock
